prompt: What characteristic best describes the Silent Lion?
successText: A lion that doesn't need attention. A lion that doesn't need recognition. Restraint.
failureText: Not quite. Remember Ashcombe's notes: later lions roar, earlier lions watch.

prompt: Who would know more about Hogwarts history than the books themselves?
successText: Either nobody knows what the Silent Lion was... or everyone forgot. Except one person. Most historians rely on books. Fortunately, Hogwarts employs one. A very old one.
failureText: Not this time — the books have already given what they can.

prompt: Peeves: "Lion waits and eagle sees. Badger keeps and serpent weighs—"

options.text: Four may knock but one may walk

successText: Peeves freezes. "Who told you that?" "You did." "Terrible source. Never trust him." He reluctantly hands over the page.
failureText: Peeves cackles and clutches the page tighter. You've heard this rhyme before — somewhere in this castle.
